secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for B-Cubed AI features (https://platform.openai.com/api-keys). Optional — the app boots without it.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth 2.0 Client ID (https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials). Optional — Sign in with Google stays hidden until configured.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Google OAuth 2.0 Client Secret paired with GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID. Optional.
